will expand its already substantial presence in Pennsylvania with a more than $800M investment to boost operations in Montgomery County.
As a result, ~300 jobs will be added over the next five years. The pharma already employs ~4500 full-time employees in the state.

The expansion, which will begin next year in Upper Merion Township, will include knocking down current buildings and constructing new ones, including a commercial-scale biologics manufacturing facility. In addition, a R&D pilot plant will be established, as well as a centralized quality control lab and manufacturing science and technology hub.
GSK's latest investment in the Keystone State follows an October 2024 announcement of an up to $800M investment to boost R&D and manufacturing at a facility in Lancaster County.

title: GSK to expand Pennsylvania presence with over $800M investment
